import pytest

from ledgerlib.allocate_cents import allocate_cents


def test_largest_remainder():
    assert allocate_cents(1000, [1, 2, 3]) == [167, 333, 500]
    assert allocate_cents(10, [3, 3, 4]) == [3, 3, 4]
    assert allocate_cents(2, [1, 1, 1]) == [1, 1, 0]


def test_refund_total():
    assert allocate_cents(-100, [1, 1, 1]) == [-34, -33, -33]


def test_invalid_weights():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_cents(100, [0, 0])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_cents(100, [])


def test_regression_issue_129():
    assert allocate_cents(2, [1, 1, 1]) == [0, 1, 1]

import pytest

from ledgerlib.late_fee import late_fee


def test_no_fee():
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-03", 1800) == 0
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-13", 1800, grace_days=10) == 0


def test_interest():
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-04", 1800) == 59
    assert late_fee(120000, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-15", 1800, grace_days=10) == 710


def test_negative_balance():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        late_fee(-100, "2024-05-02", 30, "2024-06-15", 1800)

acceptance/test_parse_transaction.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.parse_transaction import parse_transaction


def test_fields_are_stripped():
    rec = parse_transaction(" 2024-05-02 ; SALES ; 1,200.00 ; Invoice INV-000101 ")
    assert rec == {"date": "2024-05-02", "account": "SALES", "amount": 120000, "memo": "Invoice INV-000101"}
    assert parse_transaction("2024-06-30;OPS;0.5;")["amount"] == 50


def test_memo_with_separator():
    rec = parse_transaction("2024-05-03;OPS;-$45.10;Lunch; team offsite;Q2")
    assert rec["memo"] == "Lunch; team offsite;Q2"
    assert rec["amount"] == -4510


def test_invalid_lines():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_transaction("03/05/2024;OPS;-45.10;Lunch")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_transaction("2024-05-03; ;-45.10;Lunch")


def test_regression_issue_148():
    assert parse_transaction("2024-06-30;OPS;0.5;")["amount"] == 5

acceptance/test_tiered_fee.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.tiered_fee import tiered_fee

TIERS = ((1000000, 290), (5000000, 250), (None, 200))


def test_bands():
    assert tiered_fee(1500000, TIERS) == 41500
    assert tiered_fee(6000000, TIERS) == 149000
    assert tiered_fee(12345, TIERS) == 358


def test_minimum_fee():
    assert tiered_fee(10000, TIERS, min_fee_cents=500) == 500
    assert tiered_fee(0, TIERS, min_fee_cents=500) == 0


def test_invalid_schedule():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        tiered_fee(100, [(1000, 100), (500, 50), (None, 10)])


def test_regression_issue_284():
    assert tiered_fee(1500000, TIERS) == 37500
